title: New tag group window: fields, toggle off, help text, location, success
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. Open the Notifications page from the bell and select the Tag groups tab. An active location is selected (the location name shown next to the bell; change it with your initials at the top right -> Change Location).
custom_steps:
1. Click New tag group and read the dialog title and its fields (Name, Members multi-select, Public tag group toggle).
  2. Read the toggle default and the help text with the toggle off, then on.
  3. Create a group and read the success message; confirm it belongs to the active location.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A "New tag group" button opens a dialog titled "New tag group" with a Name field, a Members multi-select, and a Public tag group toggle.
  • The Public toggle is off by default; off it reads "Only you can see this group and tag it on a note.", on it reads "Everyone at this location can see this group and tag it on a note. You and any admin can rename it, change its members, or delete it."
  • A new group belongs to the active location (fixed for its life), and creating it confirms with "Tag group created".

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R6: “A New tag group button opens a dialog titled "New tag group".”
  • S6-R7: “The dialog has a Name field, a Members multi-select, and a Public tag group toggle.”
  • S6-R10: “The Public tag group toggle is off by default.”
  • S6-R11: “With the toggle off, the help text under it reads "Only you can see this group and tag it on a note."”
  • S6-R12: “With the toggle on, the help text reads "Everyone at this location can see this group and tag it on a note. You and any admin can rename it, change its members, or delete it."”
  • S6-R13: “A new tag group belongs to the active location, and that location is fixed for the life of the group.”
  • S6-R14: “Creating a group confirms with the success message "Tag group created".”
